thread:
jordan: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's pager — want to lock owners and dates for alert tuning items.

jordan: short action list:
- reduce noisy rule fanout + extend dedupe window
- tighten thresholds for redis_conn_errors on prod-api
- add quiet-hours suppression for non-critical alerts
- handback owners + update runbook entries

jordan: i can own runbook updates and coordination. who picks up the tuning?

priya: i'll take the fanout/dedupe work. plan is to increase dedupe window from 60s -> 300s for targeted rules and use a tag-based dedupe key (region + instance_type). will test in staging.

priya: staging snippet i'll try:```yaml
alert: redis_conn_errors_high
expr: sum(increase(redis_conn_errors_total[5m])) by (instance, region) > 10
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  dedupe_key: "{{region}}:{{instance_type}}"
```

simon: i'll own thresholds (#2). propose canary in eu-prod for 24h to validate before global rollout. also add auto-backout after 2h if error rate spikes.

erica: i'll handle #3 (quiet-hours suppression) and update paging policy. suggest a rule: if paging >3x in 10m for same rule then suppress page and open a ticket. i'll file the PR.

alerts-bot: created Jira ONCALL-342: "noise reduction - redis & dedupe" linking pm doc https://docs.internal/runs/pm-2026-03-20

jordan: owners: #1 priya, #2 simon, #3 erica, #4 jordan. timelines: priya -> staging test by EOD Thu (1719540000), simon -> canary Fri morning, erica -> policy PR Fri afternoon, jordan -> runbook update after these.

priya: ack, will post staging results here. also can we add dedupe-suppressed_pages metric to dashboards? helps validate.

simon: ack. i'll post canary rollout plan and automated rollback hooks.
erica: PR up, requesting SRE + oncall review.

jordan: thanks — please ping if blocked or post in #eng-oncall and tag @jordan. :thumbsup: 

alerts-bot: reminder set: /remind @eng-oncall to review ONCALL-342 results on 1719626400

erica: thanks, done.

jordan: i'll add a TL;DR to the postmortem doc once actions are completed.

priya: noted, posting results after staging run.
simon: thanks all :rocket:
